captions.text: In 2016, NASA lit a fire inside a spacecraft, on purpose.
They needed to know how fire behaves without gravity.
On Earth, hot gas rises, and flames stretch upward.
Remove gravity — no up, no down, no rise.
The flame becomes a slow blue sphere, starved of fresh oxygen.
Saffire One measured this behavior on the International Space Station.
Our physics model is validated against that flight data.
Cut the oxygen, and the flame dies.
In space, fire is a different animal. Now it is your turn.
